planted.description: LangVersion set to preview in a net10.0 project. Remove it; C# 14 is the default and preview features are not allowed without a decision.
Sync twin of an async method on the interface. Offer only the async method.
Interface plus 'Impl' class for one implementation with no real seam. Use a concrete class (and the 'Impl' suffix breaks the naming rules).
The CancellationToken parameter is not passed on; CancellationToken.None is used instead.
Null-forgiving operator hides a real null: a customer without a tier gives a NullReferenceException.
String interpolation in a log call. Use a message template with named placeholders.
Catch-all that swallows every exception and silently returns the undiscounted subtotal.
Sync over async with .Result (thread pool starvation, deadlock risk). The endpoint calls this sync method.
async void method. An exception crashes the process. Return Task.
Money is computed in double. Use decimal for all money math to avoid rounding errors.
DateTime.Now in domain logic (local time, not testable). Inject TimeProvider like the rest of the code.
Math.Round without MidpointRounding uses banker's rounding (2.345 becomes 2.34). The rounding rule is not explicit.
